candidates.title: Government requests additional credit for tram project
candidates.search_snippet: The cantonal government asked parliament on Tuesday for an additional credit of 55 million francs for the infrastructure of the tram line under construction.
candidates.source_content: The cantonal government asked parliament on Tuesday for an additional credit of 55 million francs for the infrastructure of the tram line under construction. The request follows cost increases, construction delays and design changes since the original credit was approved; parliament has not yet decided.
